name: Spade no Kuni no Alice
original_name: スペードの国のアリス
source:
Revival of the Heart no Kuni no Alice series by Quinrose, now with the name Quinrose reborn under the Otomate brand.

A fairy tale-like, but mysterious world where the hatter is the mafia and shoot-outs are a common occurrence.

The story is set in “The Country of Spades,” which is made up of four territories: White Territory, Black Territory, Hatter Mansion, and The Station. However, this country was in the midst of war and dangerous no matter where you went.

Meanwhile, the protagonist Alice—a realist who and by no means a dreamer—was saved from drowning in a lake, and by then had lost all of her memories.

She was unable remember the people she never met, the people she used to be friends with, nor the circumstances surrounding them.

People she is supposed to be meeting for the first time, who seem somehow familiar and important, and someone she has forgotten…

In a country full of unfamiliar time, Alice builds new relationships despite her discomfort, learning to accept her lost memories and insane life.

Will this realist protagonist be able to find an honest romance in an unconventional world?

[from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/05/alice-in-the-country-of-hearts-wonderful-white-world-launches-september-2-in-japan]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
QuinRose旗下《心之国的爱丽丝》系列复活之作，以Otomate品牌重新诞生。

这是一个童话般却神秘的世界：制帽匠是黑手党，枪战随处可见。

故事发生在“黑桃国”，由四个区域组成：白色领地、黑色领地、制帽匠宅邸与车站。然而，这个国家正处于战争之中，无论走到哪里都充满危险。

与此同时，主人公爱丽丝是一个现实主义者，绝非梦想家。她从湖中溺水获救后，失去了全部记忆。

她无法记起从未见过的人、曾经成为朋友的人，也不记得与他们有关的经历。

那些本应第一次见面、却不知为何熟悉而重要的人，以及某个被她遗忘的人……

在一个时间规则陌生的国度里，爱丽丝尽管不安，仍建立起新的关系，学着接受失去的记忆与疯狂的人生。

这位现实主义主人公，能在这个不合常理的世界找到真诚的爱情吗？

[来源：[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2021/05/alice-in-the-country-of-hearts-wonderful-white-world-launches-september-2-in-japan]Gematsu[/url]]
